Skip tracing

Owner phone numbers and emails, right on the lead.

Tap Skip trace on any lead, deal or address to get the owner's ranked cell numbers, emails and mailing address, with Do Not Call and TCPA litigator flags. If there's no match, it's free.

How it works

  1. Open a lead or dealOr type any address in Run an address.
  2. Tap Skip trace ownerResults in a few seconds, every owner on title.
  3. Call or textOne tap from the best number. DNC numbers are flagged.

Can I text these numbers?

Only with the owner's consent. Numbers on the Do Not Call list are flagged so you don't cold call or text them. Follow the TCPA and your state's rules.
